Diagnosis.submission: The cleanup-controller service account has insufficient RBAC permissions. The ClusterRole named configmap-cleanup-controller only grants get, list, and watch verbs on configmaps, but the cleanup-controller application requires the patch verb to remove the finalizer (cleanup.reservations.io/pending-cleanup) from the reservation-cleanup-token ConfigMap. This causes the controller to repeatedly fail with HTTP 403 Forbidden when attempting to complete the cleanup operation, leaving the reservation-cleanup-token ConfigMap stuck in a Terminating state.
